affected_objects.content: The retrieval strategy for the hierarchical memory involves first matching a query against detailed L1 nodes, and then including the corresponding L2 and L3 ancestor nodes in the results. This provides both specific details and high-level context.
關於短期記憶（STM）與長期記憶（LTM）的內部結構，存在一個尚未解決的討論。對於 LTM 是否應包含更多但更簡潔的節點，而 STM 則包含較少但更詳細的節點，或者反之，存在著相互競爭的假設。

One proposed retrieval strategy argues for a default search path: always query the lower-resolution long-term memory first to establish context, then 'zoom in' to the relevant, more detailed short-term memory. This default would only be bypassed if a query explicitly specifies a recent timeframe.

The chosen memory architecture mandates that Short-Term Memory (STM) and Long-Term Memory (LTM) are separate databases updated independently from a common source. This separation is justified because it allows LTM to maintain a high-level, up-to-date trajectory of topics without the processing delay inherent in an STM-to-LTM pipeline.
探索並實作一種多步驟或可重試的記憶體檢索機制，允許 LLM 在初次查詢結果不佳時，能重新查詢或在不同記憶體層級間進行更精細的搜尋。

There is an unresolved question regarding the internal structure of STM and LTM. It is undecided whether LTM should contain more, but briefer, nodes while STM has fewer, more detailed nodes, or if the opposite structure is more effective.

The memory architecture will treat Short-Term Memory (STM) and Long-Term Memory (LTM) as separate databases that are updated independently from a common source, such as a new meeting transcript. This explicitly rejects a pipeline model where STM content is consolidated into LTM over time.

A proposed retrieval method involves a pre-processing step to determine whether to call the short-term memory (STM) or the long-term memory (LTM) retrieval function, treating them as separate processes.
